explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/644, first question: with f(k,r) the least size of a transversal guaranteed for families of k-sets in which every r of the sets are hit by some pair {x,y}, is f(k,7) = (1+o(1))(3/4)k? In Lean subfamilyTransversalBound k 7 2 is the infimum b such that every family F of k-sets (on any type, possibly infinite) whose subfamilies of at most 7 sets each have a transversal of size ≤ 2 has a transversal of size ≤ b; it is finite (≤ 2k, proved in the file), so toNat loses nothing, and the statement is f(k,7) ~ (3/4)k. Including subfamilies of fewer than 7 sets is the natural reading (it only matters for families with fewer than 7 members, where the literal condition would be vacuous). Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
